-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): get_user_decks_with_stats
-- Tham số: usr_id text, fld_id text DEFAULT NULL::text
-- Trả về: TABLE(id text, owner_id text, type text, is_public boolean, folder_id bigint, sort_order integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, total_cards bigint, due_cards bigint, studied_cards bigint, creator_name text, creator_avatar text)
-- ==========================================

BEGIN
    -- 🛡️ IDOR FIX
    IF usr_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: usr_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        d.id::text,
        d.owner_id::text,
        d.type::text,
        d.is_public::boolean,
        d.folder_id::bigint,
        d.sort_order::integer,
        d.created_at::timestamptz,
        COALESCE(card_counts.total, 0)::bigint,
        (COALESCE(progress_counts.due, 0)
            + (COALESCE(card_counts.total, 0) - COALESCE(progress_counts.studied, 0)))::bigint,
        COALESCE(progress_counts.studied, 0)::bigint,
        p_owner.full_name::text,
        p_owner.avatar_url::text
    FROM decks d
    LEFT JOIN profiles p_owner ON p_owner.id::text = d.owner_id::text
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT dc.deck_id, COUNT(*) as total
        FROM deck_cards dc
        GROUP BY dc.deck_id
    ) card_counts ON card_counts.deck_id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            dc.deck_id,
            COUNT(*) as studied,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN uvm.due <= NOW() THEN 1 END) as due
        FROM deck_cards dc
        JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
          ON dc.word_text = uvm.word_text AND uvm.user_id::text = usr_id::text
        GROUP BY dc.deck_id
    ) progress_counts ON progress_counts.deck_id = d.id
    WHERE
        (
            (fld_id IS NULL AND d.folder_id IS NULL
                AND (d.owner_id::text = usr_id::text OR d.is_public = true))
            OR
            (fld_id IS NOT NULL AND d.folder_id::text = fld_id::text
                AND d.owner_id::text = usr_id::text)
        );
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): get_user_thematic_tags
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid
-- Trả về: json
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    result JSON;
BEGIN
    -- 🛡️ IDOR FIX
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('tag', t.tag, 'display', t.display, 'count', t.count))
    INTO result
    FROM (
        SELECT
            trim(split_part(tag_raw, '|', 1)) as tag,
            trim(split_part(tag_raw, '|', 2)) as display,
            count(*) as count
        FROM (
            SELECT unnest(string_to_array(
                substring(uvm.info from '\[TAGS\](.*?)\n'), ','
            )) as tag_raw
            FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
            WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id AND uvm.info LIKE '%[TAGS]%'
        ) sub
        WHERE tag_raw IS NOT NULL AND tag_raw != ''
        GROUP BY tag, display
    ) t;

    RETURN COALESCE(result, '[]'::json);
END;

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): bulk_insert_cards_safe
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_cards jsonb
-- Trả về: jsonb
-- ==========================================
 DECLARE
    v_inserted_count INT := 0;
    v_duplicates TEXT[] := ARRAY[]::TEXT[];
    v_invalid_count INT := 0;
    v_card JSONB;
    v_deck_id TEXT;
    v_deck_owner UUID;
    v_seen_decks TEXT[] := ARRAY[]::TEXT[];
BEGIN
    -- 1. 🚨 CHỐT CHẶN XÁC THỰC: Chống giả mạo p_user_id
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    -- 2. CHẠY BỘ ĐỆM CACHE TRỰC QUAN: Kiểm duyệt quyền sở hữu bộ bài đích
    -- (Giúp loại bỏ 99% các truy vấn lặp lại không cần thiết khi nạp thẻ cùng bộ)
    FOR v_card IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_cards)
    LOOP
        v_deck_id := v_card->>'deck_id';
        IF v_deck_id IS NULL OR v_deck_id = '' THEN
            v_invalid_count := v_invalid_count + 1;
            CONTINUE;
        END IF;

        IF NOT (v_deck_id = ANY(v_seen_decks)) THEN
            SELECT owner_id INTO v_deck_owner FROM public.decks WHERE id = v_deck_id;
            IF v_deck_owner IS NULL THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deck % không tồn tại', v_deck_id;
            END IF;
            IF v_deck_owner <> p_user_id THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: không có quyền ghi vào deck %', v_deck_id;
            END IF;
            v_seen_decks := array_append(v_seen_decks, v_deck_id);
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    -- 3. 🟢 ĐÃ VÁ LỖI 1: Tính toán danh sách trùng lặp TRƯỚC khi thay đổi dữ liệu bảng
    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT btrim(j->>'front')), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) INTO v_duplicates
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_cards) j
    WHERE btrim(coalesce(j->>'front', '')) <> ''
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.user_vocabulary_mastery u
          WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id 
            AND u.word_text = btrim(j->>'front')
      );

    -- 4. BULK INSERT TẦNG 1: Chèn hàng loạt từ vựng mới tinh
    INSERT INTO public.user_vocabulary_mastery (user_id, word_text, back, info, tags)
    SELECT 
        p_user_id,
        btrim(j->>'front'),
        j->>'back',
        j->>'info',
        -- 🟢 ĐÃ VÁ LỖI 2: Chốt chặn an toàn kiểm duyệt kiểu dữ liệu mảng tránh crash
        CASE 
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(j->'tags') = 'array' 
            THEN (SELECT ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(j->'tags')))
            ELSE ARRAY[]::TEXT[]
        END
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_cards) j
    WHERE btrim(coalesce(j->>'front', '')) <> ''
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.user_vocabulary_mastery u
          WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id 
            AND u.word_text = btrim(j->>'front')
      )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_inserted_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- 5. BULK INSERT TẦNG 2: Thiết lập liên kết mỏ neo với bộ bài
    INSERT INTO public.deck_cards (deck_id, word_text)
    SELECT 
        j->>'deck_id',
        btrim(j->>'front')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_cards) j
    WHERE btrim(coalesce(j->>'front', '')) <> ''
      AND j->>'deck_id' IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (deck_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN json_build_object(
        'inserted_count', v_inserted_count,
        'duplicate_words', v_duplicates,
        'invalid_count', v_invalid_count
    )::JSONB;
END;

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): remove_tag_from_cards
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_tag text
-- Trả về: void
-- ==========================================

BEGIN
    UPDATE user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
    SET 
        tags = array_remove(uvm.tags, p_tag),
        info = REGEXP_REPLACE(
                  REGEXP_REPLACE(uvm.info, '\[TAGS\]\s*' || p_tag || '\s*\|[^,\n]*\s*,?\s*', '', 'g'),
                  ',\s*$', '', 'g'
               )
    WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id 
      AND p_tag = ANY(uvm.tags);

    UPDATE user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
    SET info = REGEXP_REPLACE(uvm.info, '\[TAGS\]\s*(\n|$)', '', 'g')
    WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id
      AND uvm.info ~ '\[TAGS\]\s*(\n|$)';
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): sync_user_kanji_and_peaks
-- Tham số: 
-- Trả về: trigger
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    v_user_id uuid;
    v_kanji text;
    v_new_interval int;
    v_current_peak int;
    v_user_peaks jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- Lấy ID người dùng
    v_user_id := COALESCE(NEW.user_id, OLD.user_id);
    
    -- Giả sử trigger chạy sau khi bảng progress thay đổi
    -- (Logic này sẽ quét chữ Kanji từ thẻ vừa học/vừa xóa)
    
    -- Đọc bảng kỷ lục hiện tại của User
    SELECT kanji_peaks INTO v_user_peaks FROM profiles WHERE id = v_user_id;
    IF v_user_peaks IS NULL THEN v_user_peaks := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;

    -- [ĐOẠN LOGIC QUÉT VÀ TÍNH TOÁN KANJI]
    -- Đối với mỗi chữ Kanji (v_kanji) học được với điểm số mới (v_new_interval):
    -- Lấy điểm kỷ lục cũ:
    v_current_peak := COALESCE((v_user_peaks->>v_kanji)::int, 0);
    
    -- Nếu điểm mới cao hơn kỷ lục cũ -> Cập nhật Kỷ lục mới
    IF v_new_interval > v_current_peak THEN
        v_user_peaks := jsonb_set(v_user_peaks, ARRAY[v_kanji], to_jsonb(v_new_interval));
    END IF;

    -- Cập nhật bảng kỷ lục vào database
    UPDATE profiles 
    SET kanji_peaks = v_user_peaks
    WHERE id = v_user_id;

    RETURN NULL;
END;

DECLARE
    v_key text;

    v_old_peak int;
BEGIN
    -- 1. XỬ LÝ TỰ ĐỘNG CHO KANJI PEAKS
    IF NEW.kanji_mastery IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kanji_mastery THEN
        -- Khởi tạo cột kỷ lục nếu lỡ bị NULL
        IF NEW.kanji_peaks IS NULL THEN
            NEW.kanji_peaks := '{}'::jsonb;
        END IF;

        -- Duyệt qua từng chữ Kanji trong danh sách vừa học
        FOR v_key, v_val IN 
            SELECT key, value::int 
            FROM jsonb_each_text(NEW.kanji_mastery)
        LOOP
            -- Đọc điểm kỷ lục hiện tại của chữ Kanji đó
            v_old_peak := COALESCE((NEW.kanji_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
            
            -- CHỈ CẬP NHẬT: Nếu điểm học thực tế mới cao hơn điểm kỷ lục cũ
            IF v_val > v_old_peak THEN
                NEW.kanji_peaks := jsonb_set(NEW.kanji_peaks, ARRAY[v_key], to_jsonb(v_val));
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    -- 2. XỬ LÝ TỰ ĐỘNG CHO GRAMMAR PEAKS
    IF NEW.grammar_mastery IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.grammar_mastery THEN
        -- Khởi tạo cột kỷ lục nếu lỡ bị NULL
        IF NEW.grammar_peaks IS NULL THEN
            NEW.grammar_peaks := '{}'::jsonb;
        END IF;

        -- Duyệt qua từng cấu trúc Ngữ pháp trong danh sách vừa học
        FOR v_key, v_val IN 
            SELECT key, value::int 
            FROM jsonb_each_text(NEW.grammar_mastery)
        LOOP
            -- Đọc điểm kỷ lục hiện tại của cấu trúc đó
            v_old_peak := COALESCE((NEW.grammar_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
            
            -- CHỈ CẬP NHẬT: Nếu điểm học thực tế mới cao hơn điểm kỷ lục cũ
            IF v_val > v_old_peak THEN
                NEW.grammar_peaks := jsonb_set(NEW.grammar_peaks, ARRAY[v_key], to_jsonb(v_val));
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;

-- HÀM (FUNCTION): log_mastery_changes
-- Tham số:

-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    v_key text;
    v_val int;
    v_peak int;
BEGIN
    -- A. QUÉT BIẾN ĐỘNG KANJI
    IF NEW.kanji_mastery IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kanji_mastery OR NEW.kanji_peaks IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kanji_peaks THEN
        -- Tìm các key được thêm mới hoặc cập nhật điểm số
        FOR v_key, v_val IN SELECT key, value::int FROM jsonb_each_text(NEW.kanji_mastery)
        LOOP
            v_peak := COALESCE((NEW.kanji_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
            -- Nếu điểm hiện tại hoặc điểm kỷ lục bị lệch so với dữ liệu cũ -> Ghi Log biến động
            IF OLD.kanji_mastery->>v_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kanji_mastery->>v_key OR
               OLD.kanji_peaks->>v_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kanji_peaks->>v_key THEN
                
                INSERT INTO user_mastery_changes (user_id, type, key, current_val, peak_val)
                VALUES (NEW.id, 'kanji', v_key, v_val, v_peak);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        -- Tìm các key bị xóa (Có ở OLD nhưng biến mất ở NEW)
        FOR v_key IN SELECT key FROM jsonb_each_text(OLD.kanji_mastery)
        LOOP
            IF NOT jsonb_exists(NEW.kanji_mastery, v_key) THEN
                v_peak := COALESCE((NEW.kanji_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
                INSERT INTO user_mastery_changes (user_id, type, key, current_val, peak_val)
                VALUES (NEW.id, 'kanji', v_key, 0, v_peak); -- Trả điểm hiện tại về 0
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    -- B. QUÉT BIẾN ĐỘNG NGỮ PHÁP
    IF NEW.grammar_mastery IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.grammar_mastery OR NEW.grammar_peaks IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.grammar_peaks THEN
        FOR v_key, v_val IN SELECT key, value::int FROM jsonb_each_text(NEW.grammar_mastery)
        LOOP
            v_peak := COALESCE((NEW.grammar_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
            IF OLD.grammar_mastery->>v_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.grammar_mastery->>v_key OR
               OLD.grammar_peaks->>v_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.grammar_peaks->>v_key THEN
                
                INSERT INTO user_mastery_changes (user_id, type, key, current_val, peak_val)
                VALUES (NEW.id, 'grammar', v_key, v_val, v_peak);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        FOR v_key IN SELECT key FROM jsonb_each_text(OLD.grammar_mastery)
        LOOP
            IF NOT jsonb_exists(NEW.grammar_mastery, v_key) THEN
                v_peak := COALESCE((NEW.grammar_peaks->>v_key)::int, 0);
                INSERT INTO user_mastery_changes (user_id, type, key, current_val, peak_val)
                VALUES (NEW.id, 'grammar', v_key, 0, v_peak);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): clone_deck_with_dedupe
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_source_deck_id text, p_new_deck_id text
-- Trả về: jsonb
-- ==========================================
 DECLARE
    v_creator_id UUID;
    v_is_public BOOLEAN;
    v_inserted_count INT;
    v_duplicate_words TEXT[];
BEGIN
    -- 🟢 C6 FIX
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    SELECT owner_id, is_public 
      INTO v_creator_id, v_is_public
    FROM decks 
    WHERE id = p_source_deck_id;
    
    IF v_creator_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không tìm thấy bộ bài gốc';
    END IF;

    -- 🟢 C6 FIX: chỉ được clone deck public hoặc deck của chính mình
    IF v_creator_id <> p_user_id AND NOT COALESCE(v_is_public, false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: không thể clone deck private của user khác';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO user_vocabulary_mastery (user_id, word_text, back, info, tags)
    SELECT 
        p_user_id, 
        dc.word_text, 
        uvm_creator.back, 
        uvm_creator.info,
        uvm_creator.tags
    FROM deck_cards dc
    JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm_creator 
      ON dc.word_text = uvm_creator.word_text 
     AND uvm_creator.user_id = v_creator_id
    WHERE dc.deck_id = p_source_deck_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm_cloner
          WHERE uvm_cloner.user_id = p_user_id 
            AND uvm_cloner.word_text = dc.word_text
      )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO deck_cards (deck_id, word_text)
    SELECT p_new_deck_id, dc.word_text
    FROM deck_cards dc
    WHERE dc.deck_id = p_source_deck_id
    ON CONFLICT (deck_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

    SELECT count(*)::INT INTO v_inserted_count 
    FROM deck_cards WHERE deck_id = p_new_deck_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(dc.word_text), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) INTO v_duplicate_words
    FROM deck_cards dc
    WHERE dc.deck_id = p_source_deck_id
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
          WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id 
            AND uvm.word_text = dc.word_text
      );

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'inserted_count', v_inserted_count,
        'duplicate_words', v_duplicate_words
    );
END;

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): sync_mastery_from_progress
-- Tham số: 
-- Trả về: trigger
-- ==========================================
 DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID;
    v_kanji_array TEXT[];
    v_grammar_array TEXT[];
    v_kanji TEXT;
    v_grammar_point TEXT;
    v_max_val INT;
    current_kanji_mastery JSONB;
    current_grammar_mastery JSONB;
BEGIN
    v_user_id := COALESCE(NEW.user_id, OLD.user_id);

    SELECT kanji_mastery, grammar_mastery INTO current_kanji_mastery, current_grammar_mastery 
    FROM public.profiles WHERE id = v_user_id;

    IF current_kanji_mastery IS NULL THEN current_kanji_mastery := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
    IF current_grammar_mastery IS NULL THEN current_grammar_mastery := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;

    -- 🟢 C5 FIX: dùng literal CJK chars thay cho \u4e00-\u9faf (PG regex không hiểu \u escape)
    -- 一 = U+4E00, 龯 = U+9FAF
    SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT k[1]), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) INTO v_kanji_array
    FROM (
        SELECT regexp_matches(COALESCE(NEW.word_text, ''), '[一-龯]', 'g') AS k
        WHERE NEW.word_text IS NOT NULL
        UNION
        SELECT regexp_matches(COALESCE(OLD.word_text, ''), '[一-龯]', 'g') AS k
        WHERE OLD.word_text IS NOT NULL
    ) sub
    WHERE k[1] IS NOT NULL;

    SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(grammar_point), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) INTO v_grammar_array
    FROM public.grammar_dict
    WHERE position(replace(grammar_point, '～', '') in COALESCE(NEW.word_text, '')) > 0
       OR position(replace(grammar_point, '～', '') in COALESCE(OLD.word_text, '')) > 0;

    -- XỬ LÝ ĐỒNG BỘ KANJI
    IF v_kanji_array IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_kanji_array, 1) > 0 THEN
        FOREACH v_kanji IN ARRAY v_kanji_array
        LOOP
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX("interval"), 0) INTO v_max_val
            FROM public.user_vocabulary_mastery
            WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND position(v_kanji in word_text) > 0;

            IF v_max_val = 0 THEN
                current_kanji_mastery := current_kanji_mastery - v_kanji;
            ELSE
                current_kanji_mastery := jsonb_set(current_kanji_mastery, ARRAY[v_kanji], to_jsonb(v_max_val));
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    -- XỬ LÝ ĐỒNG BỘ NGỮ PHÁP
    IF v_grammar_array IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_grammar_array, 1) > 0 THEN
        FOREACH v_grammar_point IN ARRAY v_grammar_array
        LOOP
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX("interval"), 0) INTO v_max_val
            FROM public.user_vocabulary_mastery
            WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND position(replace(v_grammar_point, '～', '') in word_text) > 0;

            IF v_max_val = 0 THEN
                current_grammar_mastery := current_grammar_mastery - v_grammar_point;
            ELSE
                current_grammar_mastery := jsonb_set(current_grammar_mastery, ARRAY[v_grammar_point], to_jsonb(v_max_val));
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.profiles 
    SET 
        kanji_mastery = current_kanji_mastery,
        grammar_mastery = current_grammar_mastery
    WHERE id = v_user_id;

    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RETURN OLD;
    ELSE
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
END;
 

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): rename_deck_transaction
-- Tham số: p_old_id text, p_new_id text, p_owner_id uuid, p_type text, p_is_public boolean
-- Trả về: void
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    v_actual_owner UUID;
BEGIN
    -- 🛡️ IDOR FIX #2: bắt buộc caller phải là auth.uid()
    IF p_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_owner_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    -- 🛡️ OWNERSHIP FIX #2: xác nhận deck cũ thực sự thuộc về p_owner_id
    -- (chống trường hợp caller truyền p_old_id của người khác)
    SELECT owner_id INTO v_actual_owner FROM public.decks WHERE id = p_old_id;

    IF v_actual_owner IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deck không tồn tại: %', p_old_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_actual_owner <> p_owner_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: không sở hữu deck %', p_old_id;
    END IF;

    -- 🛡️ CHỐNG ĐỤNG CHẾ ĐỊCH VỚI DECK CŨ (chỉ khi khác id)
    IF p_old_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_new_id THEN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decks WHERE id = p_new_id) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deck mới đã tồn tại: %', p_new_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 1. Tạo vỏ bộ bài mới (hoặc UPSERT nếu old_id = new_id)
    INSERT INTO public.decks (id, owner_id, type, is_public)
    VALUES (p_new_id, p_owner_id, p_type, p_is_public)
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
      SET type = EXCLUDED.type,
          is_public = EXCLUDED.is_public;

    -- 2. Di chuyển liên kết neo từ vựng (Tầng 2) sang ID mới
    IF p_old_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_new_id THEN
        UPDATE public.deck_cards
           SET deck_id = p_new_id
         WHERE deck_id = p_old_id;

        -- 3. Xóa vỏ bộ bài cũ
        DELETE FROM public.decks WHERE id = p_old_id;
    END IF;
END;

-- HÀM (FUNCTION): prepare_deck_skeleton

    IF v_deck_owner_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deck không tồn tại';
    END IF;

    -- 🟢 C6 FIX: chỉ owner hoặc deck public mới được truy cập
    IF v_deck_owner_id <> p_user_id AND NOT COALESCE(v_is_public, false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: deck là private của user khác';
    END IF;

    -- Clone nghĩa tĩnh từ Tầng 1 của owner nếu user học deck public lần đầu
    IF v_deck_owner_id <> p_user_id THEN
        INSERT INTO user_vocabulary_mastery (user_id, word_text, back, info, tags)
        SELECT p_user_id, dc.word_text, uvm_owner.back, uvm_owner.info, uvm_owner.tags
        FROM deck_cards dc
        JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm_owner 
          ON dc.word_text = uvm_owner.word_text 
         AND uvm_owner.user_id = v_deck_owner_id
        WHERE dc.deck_id = p_deck_id
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm_user
              WHERE uvm_user.user_id = p_user_id 
                AND uvm_user.word_text = dc.word_text
          )
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        uvm.id AS word_id,
        uvm.word_text AS front,
        uvm.ef,
        uvm."interval",
        uvm.interval_count,
        uvm.due
    FROM deck_cards dc
    JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm 
      ON dc.word_text = uvm.word_text 
     AND uvm.user_id = p_user_id
    WHERE dc.deck_id = p_deck_id;
END;
 

-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): get_global_review_cards
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_now timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer
-- Trả về: json
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    result JSON;
BEGIN
    -- 🛡️ IDOR FIX
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) INTO result
    FROM (
        SELECT
            uvm.id,
            COALESCE((
                SELECT dc.deck_id FROM deck_cards dc
                WHERE dc.word_text = uvm.word_text LIMIT 1
            ), 'GLOBAL_REVIEW') AS deck_id,
            uvm.word_text AS front,
            uvm.back,
            uvm.info,
            uvm.tags,
            json_build_array(
                json_build_object(
                    'id', uvm.id,
                    'ef', uvm.ef,
                    'interval', uvm."interval",
                    'interval_count', uvm.interval_count,
                    'due', uvm.due
                )
            ) AS "progress"
        FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
        WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id
          AND uvm.due <= p_now
          AND uvm.interval > 0
        ORDER BY uvm.due ASC
        LIMIT p_limit
    ) t;

    RETURN result;
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): generate_auto_jlpt_deck_direct
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_deck_id text, p_level text, p_limit integer
-- Trả về: integer
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    inserted_count int := 0;
    r RECORD;
    v_deck_owner UUID;
BEGIN
    -- 🛡️ IDOR FIX #4: caller bắt buộc phải là auth.uid()
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    -- 🛡️ OWNERSHIP FIX #4: deck_id phải thuộc về p_user_id
    SELECT owner_id INTO v_deck_owner FROM public.decks WHERE id = p_deck_id;

    IF v_deck_owner IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deck không tồn tại: %', p_deck_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_deck_owner <> p_user_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: không có quyền ghi vào deck %', p_deck_id;
    END IF;

    -- Giới hạn an toàn: chống "bơm 1 triệu thẻ" làm sập DB
    IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit <= 0 OR p_limit > 500 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid: p_limit phải nằm trong khoảng 1..500';
    END IF;

    FOR r IN
        SELECT word, reading, meaning, kanji_meaning, example
        FROM dictionary
        WHERE level = p_level
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
              WHERE uvm.user_id = p_user_id
                AND TRIM(uvm.word_text) = TRIM(dictionary.word)
          )
        ORDER BY random()
        LIMIT p_limit
    LOOP
        INSERT INTO user_vocabulary_mastery (user_id, word_text, back, info)
        VALUES (
            p_user_id,
            r.word,
            r.reading || E'\n' || r.meaning,
            CASE WHEN r.kanji_meaning IS NOT NULL THEN '[HV] ' || r.kanji_meaning ELSE '' END ||
            CASE WHEN r.example IS NOT NULL THEN E'\n[EX1] ' || r.example ELSE '' END
        ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

        INSERT INTO deck_cards (deck_id, word_text)
        VALUES (p_deck_id, r.word)
        ON CONFLICT (deck_id, word_text) DO NOTHING;

        inserted_count := inserted_count + 1;
    END LOOP;

    RETURN inserted_count;
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): get_user_decks_v2
-- Tham số: p_user_id text, p_folder_id text DEFAULT NULL::text
-- Trả về: TABLE(id text, owner_id text, type text, is_public boolean, folder_id text, sort_order integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, total_cards bigint, due_cards bigint, studied_cards bigint, creator_name text, creator_avatar text)
-- ==========================================

BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id không khớp auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        d.id::text,
        d.owner_id::text,
        d.type::text,
        d.is_public::boolean,
        d.folder_id::text,
        d.sort_order::integer,
        d.created_at::timestamptz,
        COALESCE(card_counts.total, 0)::bigint,
        (COALESCE(progress_counts.due, 0)
            + (COALESCE(card_counts.total, 0) - COALESCE(progress_counts.studied, 0)))::bigint,
        COALESCE(progress_counts.studied, 0)::bigint,
        p_owner.full_name::text,
        p_owner.avatar_url::text
    FROM decks d
    LEFT JOIN profiles p_owner ON p_owner.id::text = d.owner_id::text
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT dc.deck_id, COUNT(*) as total
        FROM deck_cards dc
        GROUP BY dc.deck_id
    ) card_counts ON card_counts.deck_id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            dc.deck_id,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN uvm."interval" > 0 THEN 1 END) as studied,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN uvm.due <= NOW() AND uvm."interval" > 0 THEN 1 END) as due
        FROM deck_cards dc
        JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
          ON dc.word_text = uvm.word_text AND uvm.user_id::text = p_user_id
        GROUP BY dc.deck_id
    ) progress_counts ON progress_counts.deck_id = d.id
    WHERE
        (
            (p_folder_id IS NULL AND d.folder_id IS NULL
                AND (d.owner_id::text = p_user_id OR d.is_public = true))
            OR
            (p_folder_id IS NOT NULL AND d.folder_id::text = p_folder_id
                AND d.owner_id::text = p_user_id)
        );
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): upsert_progress_safe
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_session_id text, p_payload jsonb
-- Trả về: jsonb
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    v_current_session_id text;
    v_new_timestamp timestamptz;
    v_updated_count INT := 0;
    v_skipped_count INT := 0;
BEGIN
    -- 1. 🚨 CHỐT CHẶN XÁC THỰC: Đối chiếu danh tính JWT chống giả mạo p_user_id
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized';
    END IF;

    -- 2. Kiểm tra session chống đăng nhập đa thiết bị
    SELECT session_id INTO v_current_session_id 
    FROM public.active_sessions 
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

    IF v_current_session_id IS NOT NULL AND v_current_session_id <> p_session_id THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'SESSION_EXPIRED');
    END IF;

    -- 3. BULK UPDATE + COUNT trong cùng 1 statement WITH (fix bug "relation s does not exist")
    --    CTE `s` có scope trong toàn bộ statement này, bao gồm subqueries bên dưới
    WITH s AS (
        SELECT 
            btrim(j->>'word_text') AS wt,
            NULLIF(j->>'ef', '')::numeric AS ef,
            NULLIF(j->>'interval', '')::integer AS iv,
            NULLIF(j->>'interval_count', '')::integer AS ic,
            NULLIF(j->>'due', '')::timestamptz AS due
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload) j
        WHERE btrim(coalesce(j->>'word_text', '')) <> ''
    ),
    updated AS (
        UPDATE public.user_vocabulary_mastery u
        SET 
            ef = COALESCE(s.ef, u.ef),
            "interval" = COALESCE(s.iv, u."interval"),
            interval_count = COALESCE(s.ic, u.interval_count),
            due = COALESCE(s.due, u.due)
        FROM s
        WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id 
          AND u.word_text = s.wt
          AND (u.ef IS DISTINCT FROM s.ef 
               OR u."interval" IS DISTINCT FROM s.iv 
               OR u.interval_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.ic 
               OR u.due IS DISTINCT FROM s.due)
        RETURNING 1
    )
    -- 🟢 FIX: Lấy cả updated_count và skipped_count từ cùng 1 WITH scope
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated),
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s 
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM public.user_vocabulary_mastery u
             WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id AND u.word_text = s.wt
         ))
    INTO v_updated_count, v_skipped_count;

    -- 4. Cập nhật mốc thời gian đồng bộ của người dùng
    UPDATE public.profiles 
    SET mastery_updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_user_id;

    SELECT mastery_updated_at INTO v_new_timestamp 
    FROM public.profiles 
    WHERE id = p_user_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 'success',
        'message', 'Progress synchronized successfully',
        'updated_count', v_updated_count,
        'skipped_count', v_skipped_count,
        'new_timestamp', v_new_timestamp
    );
END;


-- ==========================================
-- HÀM (FUNCTION): get_dashboard_init_data
-- Tham số: p_user_id uuid, p_last_sync_time timestamp with time zone
-- Trả về: json
-- ==========================================

DECLARE
    v_server_now TIMESTAMPTZ;
    v_due_count INT;
    v_studied_count INT;
    v_study_goal JSONB;
    v_daily_stats JSONB;
    v_mastery_changes JSONB;
    v_deck_stats JSONB;
    v_deck_structure_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: p_user_id khong khop auth.uid()';
    END IF;

    v_server_now := now();

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_due_count
    FROM user_vocabulary_mastery
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
      AND due <= v_server_now
      AND "interval" > 0;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_studied_count
    FROM user_vocabulary_mastery
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
      AND "interval" > 0;

    SELECT study_goal, daily_stats, deck_structure_updated_at
      INTO v_study_goal, v_daily_stats, v_deck_structure_updated_at
    FROM profiles WHERE id = p_user_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'type', type, 'key', key,
        'current_val', current_val, 'peak_val', peak_val,
        'updated_at', updated_at
    )), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_mastery_changes
    FROM user_mastery_changes
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND updated_at > p_last_sync_time;

    -- ============================================================
    -- KEY FIX: studied chỉ đếm interval > 0, thêm due_now và status
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', d.id,
            'total', COALESCE(cc.total, 0)::bigint,
            'due', (COALESCE(pc.due, 0) + GREATEST(0, COALESCE(cc.total, 0) - COALESCE(pc.real_studied, 0)))::bigint,
            'studied', COALESCE(pc.real_studied, 0)::bigint,
            'due_now', COALESCE(pc.due, 0)::bigint,
            'status', CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(cc.total, 0) = 0 THEN 'notstudied'
                WHEN COALESCE(pc.real_studied, 0) = 0 THEN 'notstudied'
                WHEN COALESCE(pc.due, 0) > 0 THEN 'due'
                WHEN COALESCE(pc.real_studied, 0) < COALESCE(cc.total, 0) THEN 'studying'
                ELSE 'completed'
            END::text
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_deck_stats
    FROM decks d
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT deck_id, COUNT(*) as total FROM deck_cards GROUP BY deck_id) cc
           ON cc.deck_id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT dc.deck_id,
               COUNT(CASE WHEN uvm."interval" > 0 THEN 1 END) as real_studied,
               COUNT(CASE WHEN uvm.due <= v_server_now AND uvm."interval" > 0 THEN 1 END) as due
        FROM deck_cards dc
        JOIN user_vocabulary_mastery uvm
          ON dc.word_text = uvm.word_text AND uvm.user_id = p_user_id
        GROUP BY dc.deck_id
    ) pc ON pc.deck_id = d.id
    WHERE d.owner_id::uuid = p_user_id OR d.is_public = true;

    RETURN json_build_object(
        'server_now', v_server_now,
        'due_count', COALESCE(v_due_count, 0),
        'studied_count', COALESCE(v_studied_count, 0),
        'study_goal', v_study_goal,
        'daily_stats', v_daily_stats,
        'mastery_changes', v_mastery_changes,
        'deck_stats', v_deck_stats,
        'deck_structure_updated_at',
        COALESCE(v_deck_structure_updated_at, '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz)
    );
END;
